name: Voice
description: Record or type quick captures, transcribed locally on your computer. Review them, then send to To-do (one task or one per line) or Notes.

capture_audio.description: Save a recording (base64 audio, mime, duration_ms); transcribed where a model exists.

audio.description: Base64-encoded recording (WAV, M4A/MP4, WebM, Ogg or MP3), at most 8 MiB decoded.

mime.description: Audio type: audio/webm (default), audio/ogg, audio/wav, audio/x-wav, audio/mp4, audio/mpeg, audio/mp3 or audio/x-m4a; codec suffixes like ';codecs=opus' are allowed.

text.description: What to capture, up to 20,000 characters.

examples.text: Call the dentist to move Thursday's appointment

transcribe_pending.description: Transcribe waiting recordings on this device.

text.description: The corrected text, up to 20,000 characters.

retry.description: Try transcribing a failed recording again.

archive.description: Done with a capture without sending it; it stays in history.

reopen.description: Put a sent or kept capture back in the inbox.

send.description: Send a capture to `todo` or `notes`; `split: true` makes one task per line.

to.description: Where to send it: To-do or Notes.

split.description: With to=todo, make one task per line instead of one task from the first line.

text.description: Edited text to send and save instead of the stored text.

delete.confirm: Move this capture to the trash?

restore.description: Bring a capture back from trash.

inbox.sql: SELECT id, CASE WHEN text IS NULL OR trim(text) = '' THEN CASE status WHEN 'queued' THEN 'Recording' ELSE 'Recording (no text)' END WHEN length(trim(substr(text, 1, instr(text || char(10), char(10)) - 1))) > 90 THEN substr(trim(substr(text, 1, instr(text || char(10), char(10)) - 1)), 1, 88) || '…' ELSE trim(substr(text, 1, instr(text || char(10), char(10)) - 1)) END AS title, NULLIF(substr(trim(replace(substr(replace(replace(replace(char(10) || substr(text, instr(text || char(10), char(10)) + 1), char(10) || '- ', char(10)), char(10) || '* ', char(10)), char(10) || '• ', char(10)), 2), char(10), ' · ')), 1, 140), '') AS snippet, CASE WHEN created_at IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN date((created_at + ?1) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = ?2 THEN strftime('%H:%M', (created_at + ?1) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN date((created_at + ?1) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = date(?2, '-1 day') THEN 'Yesterday ' || strftime('%H:%M', (created_at + ?1) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN date((created_at + ?1) / 1000, 'unixepoch') > date(?2, '-7 day') THEN CASE strftime('%w', (created_at + ?1) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN '0' THEN 'Sun' WHEN '1' THEN 'Mon' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tue' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wed' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thu' WHEN '5' THEN 'Fri' ELSE 'Sat' END || ' ' || strftime('%H:%M', (created_at + ?1) / 1000, 'unixepoch') ELSE CAST(strftime('%d', (created_at + ?1) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) || ' ' || substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (CAST(strftime('%m', (created_at + ?1) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3) || CASE WHEN substr(date((created_at + ?1) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) <> substr(?2, 1, 4) THEN ' ' || substr(date((created_at + ?1) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) ELSE '' END END AS at, CASE WHEN duration_ms > 0 THEN (duration_ms / 60000) || ':' || substr('0' || ((duration_ms / 1000) % 60), -2) WHEN text IS NOT NULL AND trim(text) <> '' THEN (length(replace(replace(replace(trim(replace(replace(text, char(13), ' '), char(10), ' ')), '  ', ' '), '  ', ' '), '  ', ' ')) - length(replace(replace(replace(replace(trim(replace(replace(text, char(13), ' '), char(10), ' ')), '  ', ' '), '  ', ' '), '  ', ' '), ' ', '')) + 1) || CASE WHEN instr(replace(replace(replace(trim(replace(replace(text, char(13), ' '), char(10), ' ')), '  ', ' '), '  ', ' '), '  ', ' '), ' ') = 0 THEN ' word' ELSE ' words' END END AS length, error, CASE WHEN source = 'audio' THEN 'mic' END AS length_icon, status = 'queued' AS is_queued, status = 'failed' AS is_failed, status = 'ready' AS is_ready, source = 'audio' AS is_audio, audio IS NOT NULL AS has_audio, CASE status WHEN 'ready' THEN 'To review' WHEN 'failed' THEN 'Needs a look' ELSE 'Waiting for your computer' END AS section FROM captures WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND status IN ('ready', 'queued', 'failed') ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'ready' THEN 0 WHEN 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, created_at DESC LIMIT 200
inbox.description: Captures waiting for review, transcription, or a retry, newest first.

waiting.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM captures WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND status = 'queued'
waiting.description: Number of recordings waiting to be transcribed.

badge.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM captures WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND status = 'ready'
badge.description: Number of captures ready to review.

latest.description: The three most recent captures still in the inbox.

1) * 3 + 1, 3) || CASE WHEN substr(date((created_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) <> substr(?3, 1, 4) THEN ' ' || substr(date((created_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) ELSE '' END END AS at, CASE WHEN duration_ms > 0 THEN (duration_ms / 60000) || ':' || substr('0' || ((duration_ms / 1000) % 60), -2) WHEN text IS NOT NULL AND trim(text) <> '' THEN (length(replace(replace(replace(trim(replace(replace(text, char(13), ' '), char(10), ' ')), '  ', ' '), '  ', ' '), '  ', ' ')) - length(replace(replace(replace(replace(trim(replace(replace(text, char(13), ' '), char(10), ' ')), '  ', ' '), '  ', ' '), '  ', ' '), ' ', '')) + 1) || CASE WHEN instr(replace(replace(replace(trim(replace(replace(text, char(13), ' '), char(10), ' ')), '  ', ' '), '  ', ' '), '  ', ' '), ' ') = 0 THEN ' word' ELSE ' words' END END AS length, COALESCE(instr(trim(text, ' ' || char(10)), char(10)) > 0, 0) AS multi, status IN ('sent', 'archived') AS is_done, CASE status WHEN 'sent' THEN 'Sent to ' || CASE sent_to WHEN 'todo' THEN 'To-do' WHEN 'notes' THEN 'Notes' WHEN 'todo-lines' THEN 'To-do' ELSE 'Kept' END || ' ' || COALESCE(CASE WHEN sent_at IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN date((sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = ?3 THEN strftime('%H:%M', (sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN date((sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = date(?3, '-1 day') THEN 'Yesterday ' || strftime('%H:%M', (sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN date((sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') > date(?3, '-7 day') THEN CASE strftime('%w', (sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN '0' THEN 'Sun' WHEN '1' THEN 'Mon' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tue' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wed' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thu' WHEN '5' THEN 'Fri' ELSE 'Sat' END || ' ' || strftime('%H:%M', (sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') ELSE CAST(strftime('%d', (sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) || ' ' || substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (CAST(strftime('%m', (sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3) || CASE WHEN substr(date((sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) <> substr(?3, 1, 4) THEN ' ' || substr(date((sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) ELSE '' END END, '') WHEN 'archived' THEN 'Kept ' || COALESCE(CASE WHEN sent_at IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN date((sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = ?3 THEN strftime('%H:%M', (sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN date((sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = date(?3, '-1 day') THEN 'Yesterday ' || strftime('%H:%M', (sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN date((sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') > date(?3, '-7 day') THEN CASE strftime('%w', (sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN '0' THEN 'Sun' WHEN '1' THEN 'Mon' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tue' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wed' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thu' WHEN '5' THEN 'Fri' ELSE 'Sat' END || ' ' || strftime('%H:%M', (sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') ELSE CAST(strftime('%d', (sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) || ' ' || substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (CAST(strftime('%m', (sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3) || CASE WHEN substr(date((sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) <> substr(?3, 1, 4) THEN ' ' || substr(date((sent_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) ELSE '' END END, '') END AS done_label, CASE WHEN source = 'audio' THEN 'Recorded' ELSE 'Typed' END AS source_label FROM captures WHERE id = ?1 AND _deleted IS NULL

history.sql: SELECT id, CASE WHEN text IS NULL OR trim(text) = '' THEN CASE status WHEN 'queued' THEN 'Recording' ELSE 'Recording (no text)' END WHEN length(trim(substr(text, 1, instr(text || char(10), char(10)) - 1))) > 90 THEN substr(trim(substr(text, 1, instr(text || char(10), char(10)) - 1)), 1, 88) || '…' ELSE trim(substr(text, 1, instr(text || char(10), char(10)) - 1)) END AS title, NULLIF(substr(trim(replace(substr(replace(replace(replace(char(10) || substr(text, instr(text || char(10), char(10)) + 1), char(10) || '- ', char(10)), char(10) || '* ', char(10)), char(10) || '• ', char(10)), 2), char(10), ' · ')), 1, 140), '') AS snippet, CASE WHEN COALESCE(sent_at, created_at) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN date((COALESCE(sent_at, created_at) + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = ?3 THEN strftime('%H:%M', (COALESCE(sent_at, created_at) + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN date((COALESCE(sent_at, created_at) + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = date(?3, '-1 day') THEN 'Yesterday ' || strftime('%H:%M', (COALESCE(sent_at, created_at) + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN date((COALESCE(sent_at, created_at) + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') > date(?3, '-7 day') THEN CASE strftime('%w', (COALESCE(sent_at, created_at) + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN '0' THEN 'Sun' WHEN '1' THEN 'Mon' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tue' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wed' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thu' WHEN '5' THEN 'Fri' ELSE 'Sat' END || ' ' || strftime('%H:%M', (COALESCE(sent_at, created_at) + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') ELSE CAST(strftime('%d', (COALESCE(sent_at, created_at) + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) || ' ' || substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (CAST(strftime('%m', (COALESCE(sent_at, created_at) + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3) || CASE WHEN substr(date((COALESCE(sent_at, created_at) + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) <> substr(?3, 1, 4) THEN ' ' || substr(date((COALESCE(sent_at, created_at) + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) ELSE '' END END AS at, CASE sent_to WHEN 'todo' THEN 'To-do' WHEN 'notes' THEN 'Notes' WHEN 'todo-lines' THEN 'To-do' ELSE 'Kept' END AS dest, CASE WHEN sent_to IS NULL THEN 'archive' ELSE 'send' END AS dest_icon, CASE WHEN sent_to IS NOT NULL THEN 'accent' END AS dest_tone FROM captures WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND status IN ('sent', 'archived') AND (?1 IS NULL OR ?1 = '' OR text LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%') ORDER BY COALESCE(sent_at, created_at) DESC LIMIT 200
history.description: Sent and kept captures, newest first, optionally filtered by text.

q.description: Only captures whose text contains this; empty shows all.

trash.sql: SELECT id, CASE WHEN text IS NULL OR trim(text) = '' THEN CASE status WHEN 'queued' THEN 'Recording' ELSE 'Recording (no text)' END WHEN length(trim(substr(text, 1, instr(text || char(10), char(10)) - 1))) > 90 THEN substr(trim(substr(text, 1, instr(text || char(10), char(10)) - 1)), 1, 88) || '…' ELSE trim(substr(text, 1, instr(text || char(10), char(10)) - 1)) END AS title FROM captures WHERE _deleted IS NOT NULL ORDER BY _deleted DESC LIMIT 100
trash.description: Deleted captures, most recently deleted first.

summary.sql: SELECT COALESCE(r, 0) AS ready, COALESCE(w, 0) AS waiting, COALESCE(f, 0) AS failed, CASE WHEN COALESCE(r, 0) + COALESCE(w, 0) + COALESCE(f, 0) = 0 THEN 'Inbox clear' ELSE trim(CASE WHEN r > 0 THEN r || ' to review' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN w > 0 THEN CASE WHEN r > 0 THEN ' · ' ELSE '' END || w || ' waiting for your computer' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN f > 0 THEN CASE WHEN r > 0 OR w > 0 THEN ' · ' ELSE '' END || f || ' failed' ELSE '' END) END AS label FROM (SELECT SUM(status = 'ready') AS r, SUM(status = 'queued') AS w, SUM(status = 'failed') AS f FROM captures WHERE _deleted IS NULL)
summary.description: Counts of captures to review, waiting and failed, with a short label.

search.sql: SELECT id, CASE WHEN text IS NULL OR trim(text) = '' THEN CASE status WHEN 'queued' THEN 'Recording' ELSE 'Recording (no text)' END WHEN length(trim(substr(text, 1, instr(text || char(10), char(10)) - 1))) > 90 THEN substr(trim(substr(text, 1, instr(text || char(10), char(10)) - 1)), 1, 88) || '…' ELSE trim(substr(text, 1, instr(text || char(10), char(10)) - 1)) END AS title, CASE status WHEN 'sent' THEN 'Sent to ' || CASE sent_to WHEN 'todo' THEN 'To-do' WHEN 'notes' THEN 'Notes' WHEN 'todo-lines' THEN 'To-do' ELSE 'Kept' END WHEN 'archived' THEN 'Kept' ELSE 'In Voice inbox' END AS subtitle FROM captures WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND text LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 8
search.description: Captures whose text contains the search words.
